scientific.integrity: The claim follows directly from the exact SM3-I and SM3-II accumulator recurrences. The key invariant is a transversal of the cover sets containing a target coordinate; the proof establishes both sufficiency and minimality of its support size.
limitations: The result is for additive SM3-I and SM3-II without optional momentum or exponential averaging.
It is an adversarial gradient-history boundary, not a frequency claim about neural-network training.
The exact attenuation comparison uses no denominator epsilon.
The one-round transversal number does not classify every possible long-history contamination pattern.

title: Cover-transversal obstruction to per-coordinate adaptivity in SM3
